Assistant A provides a correct and efficient solution with O(1) space and O(log(min(n, m))) time, which is actually within the requested O(n) time bound. Although A incorrectly states that an O(n) time and O(1) space solution is impossible, the implementation itself is accurate and meets the space constraint. Assistant B’s solution uses array slicing (`nums1[i:]`, `nums2[j:]`), which creates new lists and therefore does not achieve O(1) space complexity. B’s claim of O(1) space is incorrect. Thus, Assistant A is more accurate and reliable overall.
